name: PharmaKG-Bench
description: PharmaKG-Bench is a structured knowledge benchmark designed to support research on knowledge-grounded reasoning, GraphRAG systems, and intelligent decision support for deviation investigation in regulated manufacturing environments. The deposit contains 250 expert-informed knowledge artifacts (including deviation cases, SOP fragments, CAPA records, and GMP requirements), a manufacturing knowledge-graph ontology, a benchmark task taxonomy, 100 gold-standard questions with answers, an evaluation methodology, and detailed materials from a pilot comparative evaluation on 40 stratified questions. The resource is intended to facilitate reproducible evaluation of multi-hop reasoning, compliance accuracy, evidence traceability, and related capabilities of knowledge-based and GraphRAG systems. It is designed to be extensible through its modular ontology and task taxonomy.
